title: Existing patient wants one specific day and time

persona.name: Daniel Kim
persona.style: efficient and a little rushed, polite, no small talk

goals.goal: Say you're an existing patient who was seen there last year and want a follow-up for your right shoulder.
Ask for next Tuesday at two thirty in the afternoon specifically.
If that exact time isn't free, ask for the closest time on that same Tuesday before taking another day.
Confirm the final day and time back to them.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi, I'm an existing patient who was seen last year, and I need to schedule a follow-up for my right shoulder.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, this is Daniel Kim. Can you help me get that follow-up appointment?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please provide your full date of birth, Daniel.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: June 22, 1979. Can I get next Tuesday at two thirty in the afternoon for that appointment?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Just to confirm, can you please spell your first and last name for me? I have your date of birth as June twenty second nineteen seventy nine.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, that's D-A-N-I-E-L K-I-M. Is next Tuesday at two thirty available?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to look up your record using the phone number you have on file with us? If so, please tell me that number. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Please look it up with the phone number; it's 805-555-0117. So, is next Tuesday at two thirty free?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one one seven. And your date of birth as June twenty second nineteen seventy nine. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, that's right. Do you have an opening next Tuesday at two thirty?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I wasn't able to find your record in our system. I can connect you to our patient support team to help with scheduling your follow-up. Please stay on the line. Transferring you now Thank you.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Hello. You've reached the [company] test line. Goodbye.
